memories.content: Lucia Ferreyra is the director of a nonprofit organization. She has prepared an unsolicited concept note describing a project she hopes the Alder Foundation will fund. She intends to send it to the program officer at the Alder Foundation. She has no prior relationship with the program officer.

The Alder Foundation is a philanthropic organization that accepts unsolicited concept notes. Lucia Ferreyra can send her concept note to the program officer via email. The program officer may read it and decide whether to respond substantively (e.g., with a request for a full proposal, a meeting invitation, or detailed feedback) within a month.
